svg.title: Cinatra system architecture
svg.desc: Cinatra sits at the center of its ecosystem. People use its browser workspace. Connectors let Cinatra call third-party applications through APIs or MCP. External applications invoke Cinatra through its MCP server, embed its assistant stream, or exchange webhooks. External agents communicate through A2A. A separate marketplace supplies and receives extensions. Portable agent runtimes execute OAS definitions, including agents composed from other agents. The core contains shared permissions across Personal, Projects, Teams, Organizations and Workspace scopes, and an extension system with dedicated assistants, agents, connectors, skills and artifacts. The Agents card contains Memory in Open Knowledge Format, a portable Runtime with agent composition, an isolated Sandbox, and HITL interactions through AG-UI. Background execution and persistent data sit outside the core.

g.text: Run work with reusable definitions and lifecycle steps.
BullMQ + Redis · scheduling, retries and notifications
Persistent agent runs and human input
PostgreSQL records and dedicated artifact storage
Agents, assistants, connectors, skills and artifact types
